def two_unique_nums(nums):
    # Convert the list of lists into a set to remove duplicates
    unique_nums = set()
    for sublist in nums:
        unique_nums.update(sublist)
    # Convert the set back to a list and return the first two unique numbers
    return list(unique_nums)[:2]
